channel.title: Sound baths in Colorado Springs · Sound Bath Calendar
channel.description: A weekly-updated calendar of sound baths in Colorado Springs, Colorado: dates, times, venues, prices, and ticket links for every listed session. Part of the Front Range sound bath calendar.

item.title: Sunset Reset: Floating Full Moon Sound Bath
item.description: A 90-minute poolside full-moon sound bath at Ascend Spa & Wellness, Hotel Polaris, Colorado Springs, Thursday evening; $55 on a lounger or $85 floating. Crystal bowls, gongs, flutes and chimes. Where: Ascend Spa & Wellness at Hotel Polaris, Colorado Springs. Price: $55–85. Details: https://soundbathcalendar.com/event/sunset-reset-floating-full-moon-sound-bath-2026-08-27-ascend-spa-wellness-at-hotel-polaris/
